description.value: Sons of Vancouver is an independently owned craft distillery on Vancouver's North Shore, founded in 2015 and now centered on a flavour-driven rye whisky program fermented, distilled, and matured entirely on-site. The tasting room offers hand-crafted cocktails made with in-house spirits alongside retail bottle sales, making it a distinctive destination stop rather than a mid-ride refuel. Originally known for its No. 82 Amaretto, the distillery has pivoted to becoming a serious rye whisky producer with limited special releases that often sell out within a day.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Sons of Vancouver is an active craft distillery and tasting room at 1431 Crown St, North Vancouver, with cocktails and retail bottle sales available to visitors. Phone and address match between OSM and website; however, OSM records the email as info@sonsofvancouver.com while the website consistently uses info@sonsofvancouver.ca — a domain mismatch worth flagging. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Email domain mismatch: OSM records info@sonsofvancouver.com but the website consistently uses info@sonsofvancouver.ca — the .ca domain should be treated as authoritative.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A working craft distillery with an active tasting room and retail sales; a legitimate destination stop for recreational and touring cyclists exploring the North Shore.

wow_evidence: independently owned craft distillery... tasting room offers hand-crafted cocktails... limited special releases that often sell out within a day
